# Synthetic examples

`training-pump-manual.txt` is an authored fictional pump manual; it contains no
manufacturer material. `training-pump-temperature.csv` contains four authored
temperature observations at five-minute UTC intervals: 70, 75, 78 and 82 °C.

These examples are for learning and testing, not observations of real equipment.
Keep copies visibly synthetic/demo when uploading them. No customer dataset or
third-party PDF is included.
